text: hey whatever route this is [Image #13] where i have all the text and rect decal capability with the textures and all of that, we want to fold that into the mesh studio painting, where i actually spend my time. this currently has better text and rect capabilities and full texture capabilities than the other does and that is silly. a proper fold would bring all the capabilities over without hurting performance which should be easy since this route has proper dragging capabilities
resolution: Folded the materials/decal composer's rich authoring (real-font text, rect with shader+image fills, image, neon) into the mesh Studio painter as a new paint-LAYER KIND. (1) Extracted the composer's node-editing vocabulary into a shared editors/decal/ module (decalEdit pure CRUD, DecalNodeFields controls, DecalStage drag canvas) and refactored the composer to consume it with zero behaviour change (7/7 source.test green, 8/8 new decalEdit parity tests). (2) Persisted decals on the model branch: ModelDecal (a DecalDoc anchored to a face UV at a scale) + decals[] on StoredModel + a modelDecalsSet event (whole-list replace, undoable, inverse) + useStudioModel decals/setDecals; PaintLayerMeta gained kind:'paint'|'decal' (11/11 modelStream green incl. new decal test). (3) Wired the painter: a decal is a layer whose pixels come from a DecalDoc rendered offscreen into a hidden full-atlas StaticSurface at its UV anchor, read back (readSurfacePixels — importing @reactjit/capture auto-flipped -Dhas-capture, confirmed in build flags) into the decal's paint layer, which composites + bakes to the paintRef like any layer (zero extra runtime texture). Add a decal layer, author its doc on a flat stage in the panel (full composer power), click the model to place it on the surface, drag to re-anchor, size buttons scale it; the doc+anchor persist (lossless re-edit). (4) Coalesced drag/slider gestures into one undo entry so the stack doesn't flood. Verified: SHIP_RUN_PACKAGE=0 rjit ship hmsc-int builds clean, the binary boots to READY with the decal module graph evaluated, and all decal-adjacent editor suites pass with no regressions. Live decal-on-mesh authoring to be eyeballed in rjit dev (Paintable content can't be headless-captured).
